gate_interpretation: Cohen's kappa is -0.0338 at 89.0% observed agreement and a prevalence index of 0.89. That combination is the kappa paradox (Feinstein & Cicchetti 1990): the raters agree on almost every item and almost always in the same category, so expected agreement is near-total and kappa has no room to be positive. Gwet's AC1 = 0.8772 and PABAK = 0.7800 on the same data. REPORT ALL OF THEM: the P1 gate is not met on its stated statistic, and the reason is a property of the sample, not evidence that the annotators disagreed.
